bug.title: 303 bass auto-mutation cycle counts were driven by random note addresses and double-counted in reverse
bug.impact: RANDOM direction jumping onto step zero could mutate notes/probability before a complete bar; REVERSE direction counted reaching step zero and returning to the final step as two bars, doubling effective mutation rate.
bug.reproduction: seed 77, 16-step random 303: picks 9,1,0,0 on first four transitions, old bars=2 and one mutation after only five played steps. Reverse len4: old increments bars on both 0 and 3 each cycle.
bug.correction: Track elapsed random transitions in an unused seq_track_t alignment byte; wrap only after part len transitions. For reverse count only return to last/first-played step. Leave forward, pingpong, drum, clocks, RNG selected pitch, SMC, OTA and project serialization unchanged.
bug.duplicate_check: No matching active owner or PR found; separate from BF024 motion, PR95 pingpong bounds, clock, SMC and Data Safety.
